description: Opus R unit 5: multi-accuracy re-roll order. Weavile (Compound Eyes) uses Triple Axel on Skarmory at +1 evasion. First hit (hitStepAccuracy): ModifyAccuracy 90 -> 117, then the -1 net stage truncates to 87. Hits 2 and 3 (Champions hitStepMoveHitLoop): 90 / (4/3) = 67.5 as a float first; ModifyAccuracy's chained Compound Eyes is dropped because the relay value is not an integer, and randomChance(67.5, 100) = random(100) < 67.5 succeeds 68 times in 100. Extremes mode (damage rolls min and max).
